settings.title: Settings
settings.backendDescription: Choose the hardware platform that runs the model.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: Works, but slow; not recommended for large models.

settings.promptDescription: Tells the model to use specific spellings or styles. Not fully reliable, but it helps with proper names and technical terms.
settings.promptPlaceholder: E.g.: Biology lecture about the mitochondria, the ribosome and DNA.
settings.promptTooLong: Whisper only uses the last ~224 tokens; the rest is ignored.
settings.maxLenDescription: Sets the maximum length of each segment in characters. Enter 0 for no limit.
settings.suppressNstDescription: Avoids text that is not spoken in the audio, e.g. (dramatic music), although it may slow down processing.
settings.normalizeDescription: If the file has a low volume, it is normalized before transcribing to improve the transcription quality.
settings.threadsDescription: Threads used by the transcription engine. By default, half of the cores ({{default}} of {{total}}).
settings.showCaptionsDescription: Turns the subtitles over the video on or off.
settings.videoHeightDescription: Sets the height of the video panel in pixels (300–600).
settings.uiLanguageDescription: Choose the language of the app.
settings.previewCacheDescription: H.264 copies of videos that cannot be played directly. It takes up {{size}}.
settings.thirdPartyIntro: {{app}} uses the following open-source components. Thanks to their authors.
